    Polynomial functions and covers by polynomial images #

    A function (σ → k) → k is polynomial if it is evaluation of a multivariate polynomial. A map into a vector space is polynomial if all its linear functionals are. The main result, not_univ_subset_iUnion_range, says that over an infinite field a vector space of dimension r is not covered by finitely many images of polynomial maps from affine spaces of dimension less than r.

    This replaces the dimension theory of constructible sets in Step 1 of the manuscript's Proposition 2.1.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.eval_bind₁_eq {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {σ : Type u_2} {τ : Type u_3} (x : τ → k) (q : σ → MvPolynomial τ k) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.bind₁ q) p) = (MvPolynomial.eval fun (i : σ) => (MvPolynomial.eval x) (q i)) p
    source
